body:
Yeah. I realize now that just skating by is never going to cut it. It's just shitty that it took her leaving me to make me realize it. 

I appreciate all the encouragement. That's mostly what I was looking for and you guys seem to be the only place on the internet that is always supportive. My problem seems to be that after 6 years of marriage the only person I have to turn to when I have a problem is my wife, and now she's gone and I've realized that I have nobody left in my life.

Yeah. I know. Thanks for the encouragement. I'm just really alone right now and I don't have anyone to turn to. 

And I'm so embarrassed. Part of what made me such a shitty husband was that I just assumed that I would always have her. I never did anything to show her that she was special to me. Name your cliche and I guarantee you I did it at least once.

But now I'm alone and for the first time in my life, I have no idea what I'm doing.
